network_status.network: Evento alluvionale del 4-6 giugno 2002 nel territorio biellese
network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto documenta la distruzione del ponte sul Rio Ara, ma la misura pubblicata è sul Cervo a Passobreve e non viene trasferita al tributario della valle Elvo.
network_status.summary_en: The report documents destruction of the Rio Ara bridge, but the published measurement is on the Cervo at Passobreve and is not transferred to the Elvo-valley tributary.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
